legs.name: Kyoto, Nara and Osaka
legs.line: Sunny Osaka, dry Friday, very wet Saturday
legs.lede: Thursday is sunny all day in Osaka, 24°. Friday is cloudy and dry until about 21:00, good for Fushimi Inari at 07:00. Saturday has steady rain from midnight, heavier from 09:00, so the bamboo grove is wet but short.

legs.name: Tokyo: Hibiya and Ginza
legs.line: Wet Saturday, cloudy Sunday, wet Monday
legs.lede: Saturday has rain from midday, steady and light over the fireworks. Sunday is cloudy and probably dry. Monday has rain at times from the morning.

legs.name: Hong Kong
legs.line: Very hot, then a few showers
legs.lede: The Hong Kong Observatory has fine, dry, very hot weather to Sat 24, then sunny spells with a shower or two, 26 to 30°, by Tue 27. Champi is now forecast to turn north-east, away from Hong Kong.

typhoon:
Typhoons

Champi has become an extratropical low, moving north-east past Kyushu and south of Shikoku tonight. A front stalled near the Izu Islands, with a new low on it, is driving Tokyo's rain: peak tonight to dawn Tue 27, locally about 30 mm an hour in southern Kanto, up to 120 mm by noon, then easing in the morning. Hong Kong is unaffected: a fresh easterly midweek, fine by Friday.

Backup booked: Mercure Tokyo Hibiya, Fri 23 to Sat 24. King Privilege Room, booked direct on the Mercure website. If the typhoon threatens the Sat 24 Shinkansen, take a Nozomi to Tokyo on Fri 23 instead and stay here (check-in 14:00, check-out 11:00), then move to the Blossom Hibiya nearby on Sat 24. Cancel it on the Mercure website by 18:00 Japan time on Thu 22 if not needed. Free until then.

method.intro: Each day gets one combined rain chance, a weighted average of the sources that reach it. tenki.jp carries the most weight. Its figures also drive the time-of-day charts and millimetres. The others are there to confirm or flag a split.

sets.label: Up to 7 days out
rows: Best at catching rain, hourly timing and temperature. Can over-call rain
Fewest false alarms. Its 7-day forecast only
Ranked most accurate by Tokyo Shoko Research, 2022 to 2024

rules: Where tenki.jp gives 6-hour blocks, its chance is the highest block between 06:00 and midnight, so rain overnight before you're up doesn't count against the day.
The Global Forecasting Model's millimetres and AccuWeather's wording are turned into a chance: dry 10%, a stray shower 35%, showers or a little rain 50%, rain 70 to 75%, heavy rain 85%.
When tenki.jp alone calls rain, it's flagged as a split and read as possible, not likely. It catches nearly all real rain but also calls rain that doesn't come.
Temperatures come from tenki.jp, which beat JMA on temperature error at every range out to 7 days.
In Hong Kong the Hong Kong Observatory will lead once its 9-day forecast reaches the trip. Google and Apple Weather can't be read from here.
